title: TUI notes sweep T2: launch, lineup editor, panes, report viewer and spec status
lead: One TUI-only slice that fixes a bug in the launch replan, the lineup editor's `esc`, the Roadmap item pane's scroll keys, the matrix pane's wrap width, the report viewer's draw path and answer order, the dropped-launch spec status, and four small test and docs gaps, all taken from the later notes of S168, S166, S177, S181, S184, S146 and S147. Nothing here touches `internal/engine`, `internal/daemon` or `cmd`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decision 2026-10-31: later-notes rows fold into sweep slices and are retired after the sweep is filed. This slice is hosted on S190 (S168 later notes) and folds S186, S187, S190, S191, S193, S199 and S201. Every item below was re-checked against the code at HEAD of main on 2026-10-31. The items, with their source row and note number:

1. **Replan with no plan drops the launch** (S187 item 1, a bug). After an edit, a replan reply with neither a plan nor an error calls `dropLaunch` and shows `No run plan returned`, although `l.prev` holds the plan the owner was looking at (`internal/tui/launch.go:275-279`; the error branch at `:264-274` restores `l.prev` and `confirmLaunch`).
2. **`esc` in the custom-entry fields closes the whole lineup editor** (S187 item 2). `editLineup` returns `lineupDiscard` on `esc` before it looks at `e.custom` (`internal/tui/lineup.go:112-114`), so Waves and launch both lose every edit. `docs/dashboard.md:1338` says `esc` discards "including custom fields"; this slice changes that to a step back (*proposed*).
3. **The Roadmap item pane does not scroll by line, page or to the ends** (S190 items 1 and 2). Only `ctrl+d`/`ctrl+u` act in it; `j`, `k`, `up`, `down`, `pgup`, `pgdown`, `g`, `G` do nothing, and the docs say so (`docs/dashboard.md:370-372`). The matrix pane has line and page scroll (`internal/tui/roadmap.go:89-100`, selected by `matrixPaneOpen` at `internal/tui/model.go:697`) and no `g`/`G`. The Waves item pane has page and line keys (`internal/tui/waves.go:934`).
4. **The matrix pane wraps first lines two columns too narrow** (S190 item 3). `matrixLines` wraps every line at `w-4` (`internal/tui/roadmap.go:162`), but only continuation lines hang two spaces; a first line needs only `w-2` after the pane indent.
5. **The stop and budget rows are not highlighted in the lineup editor** (S191 item 1). Role rows are drawn with `TabActive` when focused (`internal/tui/lineup.go:262-312`); the stop row and the two budget rows get only a `> ` prefix (`:316-345`).
6. **A commit-stopped run has no Ready row test** (S191 item 3). The Ready row follows `committed` and `Landed`, not `StopAfter` (`internal/tui/overview.go:1466-1510`); no test sets `stop_after` `commit` and reads the row.
7. **`docs/dashboard.md` does not mention the neutral approve prompt** (S191 item 5). `promptWidth` asks `Approve run RUN?` when the run's item is unknown (`internal/tui/model.go:1430-1432`); the Approve paragraph (`docs/dashboard.md:731-743`) names only the land and commit questions.
8. **A failed `spec.answer` write after the launch was dropped shows nothing** (S193 item 2). `specAnswerMsg` is ignored when no spec state is active (`internal/tui/model.go:385-389`), so the error is lost.
9. **Spec status wording after a skipped or failed sitting** (S193 items 3 and 4). `finishLaunchSpec` ends with `l checks again`, which is terse (`l` starts the whole launch flow again), and after a failed answer write it still says the item `waits on N spec questions` although the owner answered them all (`internal/tui/launch.go:345-358`; the text is pinned by `internal/tui/launch_test.go:1116`).
10. **Run IDs: no test at the exact width** (S199 item 1). `settleRunIDs` switches at `idW + 2 + restW > w - textColumn` (`internal/tui/overview.go:799-809`); a two-column shift went unnoticed in S146.
11. **The report viewer has the S147 draw-path and answer-order faults** (S201 item 1, owner decision 2026-10-30). `reportOn` writes the pane (`m.pane.reportName = ""`, `internal/tui/report.go:55-66`), and it runs in the draw path; `renderOn` only reads and `settleRender` writes where the pane changes (`internal/tui/card.go:161-181`). `fetchReport` keeps no ask number, so an older reply for the same report name can overwrite a newer one (`report.go:68-100`; renders use `renderSeq`, `internal/tui/model.go:172`).
12. **The wrapped blocked-wave refusal is not pinned at 80 columns** (S186 item 4). `TestWavesLaunchShowsTheBlockedRefusal` and `TestWavesStartRefusalKeepsTheTicks` run at 100 columns and squash whitespace (`internal/tui/waves_test.go:1482-1507`).

Dropped, with the reason (for the manifest and the retired rows):

- S186 items 1, 2, 3 (repeated quoted title, ambiguous `untick ... or land ...` wording, `%q` escapes): the text is built in `internal/daemon/build.go:70-112`; it needs `internal/daemon`, so it cannot ride an N-class slice. Moved to the manifest.
- S187 item 3 (editor hint drop at 50 columns) and item 4 (usage text order): hint priority is a design call, and the usage layout matches `ork wave start` (`internal/cli/cli.go:44-52`); no defect.
- S190 item 4 (Overview 80-column hint tie): the tie is a drop order, not a defect; the docs already give the 80x24 line (`docs/dashboard.md:1523-1530`). Item 5 (a doc line over 80 columns): no line in that paragraph is over 80 now. Item 6 (guide anchors) and S193 item 1: both belong to the guide and design re-anchor slice. Item 7 (`m role matrix` label): wording only, no room analysis.
- S191 item 2 (spec-check directory of a commit-stopped run): cleanup is in `internal/daemon/runs.go` and `internal/daemon/speccheck_state.go`; E-class. Item 4 (bare `land`/`commit` in the editor row): the editor row is pinned by tests as `stop: land`; wording preference. Item 6 (rollback): the owner kept it on 2026-10-29.
- S193 item 5 (full title in the sitting vs short title on the row): same as Waves; a design choice.
- S199 items 2 (hysteresis), 3 (short step part fallback), 4 (non-live Running rows) and the golden half of item 5: each needs a layout decision or a new golden with no defect to fix.
- S201 items 2 and 3 (`loadFinishedEngine` and `openRun` error mapping), 4 (viewer error text for an unreadable `run.json`) and 5 (`not the listed file`): they are in `internal/daemon/runs.go` and `internal/engine/approval.go:309`. S201 also held daemon items; they are left out here.

Golden views: none should change (the new highlight shows only on a focused stop or budget row, which no golden selects); if `go test ./internal/tui -update` rewrites one, review the diff and explain it in the report.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestReplanWithNoPlanRestoresThePreviousPlan` (`internal/tui/launch_test.go`, beside the replan tests): open a launch, reach the confirmation, edit the lineup, answer the replan with `launchMsg{}` holding no plan and no error; the confirmation for the old plan is back and `m.launch` is not nil. Fails first: the launch is dropped and the status is `No run plan returned`.
- `TestEscInCustomEntryOnlyClosesTheCustomFields` (`internal/tui/lineup_test.go`): in the Waves editor press `c`, type, press `esc`: the editor is still open, `e.custom` is false, the row values are as before the entry; a second `esc` discards the editor. The same in the launch editor. The hint in custom entry reads `esc back` (not `esc discard`). Fails first: `esc` discards the editor.
- `TestRoadmapItemPaneScrollsByLinePageAndEnds` (`internal/tui/roadmap_test.go`): with a long item pane open, `j` and `down` add a line, `k` and `up` remove one (not below 0), `pgdown` and `pgup` move by the pane's room, `G` and `end` go to the last line, `g` and `home` to the first; none of them move the roadmap cursor. Fails first: offset stays 0. A short pane stays at 0.
- `TestMatrixPaneScrollsToTheEndsWithGAndG` (`internal/tui/matrix_test.go`, beside `TestMatrixPaneScrollsLikeTheItemPane`, `:173`): the same two keys in the matrix pane. Fails first: `g`/`G` do nothing.
- `TestRoadmapItemPaneHintOffersLineAndPage`: the Roadmap item pane hint lists `pgup/pgdown page` and `j/k line` as the matrix pane's does, and drops them before `esc close` at 80 columns (`internal/tui/hint_test.go` style). Fails first: only the matrix pane lists them.
- `TestMatrixPaneFirstLineUsesTheFullWidth` (`internal/tui/matrix_test.go`, beside `TestMatrixPaneWrappedLinesHang`, `:394`): at 80 columns a matrix line of exactly 78 characters stays on one line, a longer one wraps with its first line up to 78 columns and its continuations at 76 plus the two-space hang. Fails first: the first line breaks at 76.
- `TestLineupEditorHighlightsTheStopAndBudgetRows` (`internal/tui/lineup_test.go`): with the stop row focused, then each budget row, the row's line is rendered with `h.m.cfg.Theme.TabActive` (compare with `Theme.TabActive.Render(plain)` as `internal/tui/roadmap_test.go:407` does); a role row still is. Fails first: only the `> ` prefix differs.
- `TestReadyRowForACommitStoppedRun` (`internal/tui/landing_test.go`, with `landingHarness`): a committed run with `"stop_after":"commit"` shows a Ready row with its branch and the `slicer land ...` command, and is selectable. It pins today's behavior and should pass; if it does not, the failure is a finding to report, not to fix here.
- `TestFailedSpecAnswerAfterTheLaunchWasDroppedShowsAStatus` (`internal/tui/speccheck_test.go`): answer the last spec question, press `esc` before the write returns, deliver `specAnswerMsg` with an error; `actionStatus` names the item and the error. Fails first: the status stays empty.
- `TestSpecStatusAfterAFailedAnswerWriteSaysTheAnswersWereNotSaved` (`internal/tui/launch_test.go`, beside `:1116`): when `SpecAnswer` fails, the status after the sitting reads `S90: answers not saved; l starts the launch again` (the error text first, as now); when the owner skips, it reads `S90 waits on 2 spec questions; l starts the launch again`. Fails first: the old `l checks again` and the count. Update the assertion at `launch_test.go:1116` to the new text.
- `TestSettleRunIDsSwitchesAtTheExactWidth` (`internal/tui/runcard_test.go`, near `:824`): rows whose id and rest fill `w - textColumn` exactly keep their ids; one column less drops them in every row of the section. Fails first only if the boundary is off by one; it pins the edge S146 missed.
- `TestReportOnNeverWritesThePane` (`internal/tui/report_test.go`): after the viewer opens, a snapshot whose run no longer lists that report makes `reportOn()` return 0 and leaves `pane.reportName` unchanged; `settleReport()` then clears it. Fails first: `reportOn` clears the name.
- `TestReportOlderAnswerIsDropped`: ask for a report, close it, ask again (a second ask number); deliver the first reply last; the text shown is the second reply's. Fails first: the older reply overwrites the newer.
- `TestBlockedWaveRefusalWrapsAt80Columns` (`internal/tui/waves_test.go`): at 80x24 the refusal `B waits on A "Alpha" (in this wave, not done); untick B or land A first` shows on wrapped status lines with no word cut and no line over 80 columns, without squashing whitespace. It pins current behavior; a failure is a finding to report.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first, in the order above; watch each go red for the reason given. Re-anchor every cited line in the worktree first (the notes' lines have drifted: S187's `launch.go:~268` is `:275` today).

1. Item 1: in `applyLaunch`, make the `msg.plan == nil` branch behave as the error branch when `l.prev != nil` (restore `l.plan, l.params`, clear `l.prev`, `confirmLaunch`) and drop the launch only when there is no previous plan; keep the status text.
2. Item 2: in `editLineup`, handle `esc` after the `e.custom` check: in custom entry it sets `e.custom = false` and returns `lineupNone`; otherwise `lineupDiscard`. In `keys.go` the custom-entry hint pairs `esc back` with `tab/shift+tab field` and `enter use entry`. Update `docs/dashboard.md:1338` ("`esc` steps back from the custom fields; a second `esc` discards the editor").
3. Item 3: in `model.go` widen the `matrixPaneOpen()` case to any open item pane on the Roadmap (a small helper `roadmapPaneOpen()` beside `matrixPaneOpen`), add `First` and `Last` to the keys it takes, and let `scrollMatrix` (rename it `scrollRoadmapPane`) set the offset to 0 for first and to a large value for last (`scrollItemPane` already clamps, `roadmap.go:145-151`). Show the keys in the hint at `keys.go:395-403` for every Roadmap item pane. Change the help line at `view.go:850-852` so the Roadmap's `pgdown/pgup` reads `page rows or scroll a pane` as elsewhere. Update the docs at `:163` and `:370-373` ("the Roadmap item pane does not take them" goes) and `:1519-1521` (`g`/`G`). Mark the behavior *proposed*.
4. Item 4: replace the single `wrapText(text, max(w-4, 1))` in `matrixLines` with a hang wrap: the first line at `max(w-2, 1)`, the rest of the text re-wrapped at `max(w-4, 1)`. Put the helper beside `matrixLines`; do not change `wrapText`.
5. Item 5: in `editorBody`, render the stop row and the focused budget row with `th.TabActive.Render` when focused, as role rows are.
6. Items 6 and 7: the Ready row test (no code), and the `Approve run RUN?` sentence in the Approve paragraph of `docs/dashboard.md`.
7. Items 8 and 9: in the `specAnswerMsg` case, when there is no active spec state and `msg.err != nil`, set `m.actionStatus = msg.item + ": " + actionError(msg.err)`. Record per sitting which items had a failed write (a small field on the spec state) and use it in `finishLaunchSpec`. Change `l checks again` to `l starts the launch again` and update the tests that pin it.
8. Item 10: the boundary test only; change `settleRunIDs` only if the test finds an off-by-one, and then say so in the report.
9. Item 11: make `reportOn` a pure read, add `settleReport` (clear `reportName` when `reportOn() == 0`) and call it where `settleRender` is called (`model.go:355`, `pane.go:223`); add `reportSeq` to the model and a `seq` field to `reportMsg`, store it in `renderFetch.seq`, and drop a reply whose seq is not the latest for that name, as `renderArrived` does (`card.go:257-270`).
10. Item 12: the 80-column test only.
11. CHANGELOG last, so a parallel slice's entry does not conflict: one bullet under `## Unreleased` starting "S190:" listing the user-visible changes (replan, custom `esc`, item pane keys, highlight, status wording), marked *proposed* where the behavior is new.

Do not touch `internal/engine`, `internal/daemon`, `cmd` or `internal/cli`, and no new dependency. Run `go test ./internal/tui -update` only if a golden changes for a reason you can explain.

UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, `slicer check`, `adj lint`.
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui` passes with no golden rewritten.
- `rg -n "l checks again" internal docs` finds nothing.
- `rg -n "internal/(engine|daemon)|cmd/" ` over this slice's diff stat shows no such path.
- [HUMAN CHECK] At 100x30 and at 80x24: open a Roadmap item, scroll its pane with `j`, `k`, `pgdown`, `pgup`, `G`, `g`; open the matrix pane and read its wrapped lines; open the Waves lineup editor, press `c`, then `esc` once (back to the rows) and again (editor closes); move to the stop and budget rows and see them highlighted.
- [HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND] After landing and rebuilding `~/bin/ork`, answer a spec question, press `esc` while it records, and see an error status if the daemon refuses the write.
